title: Exploring the Boundaries of Content Moderation in Text-to-Image Generation
reasoning: The paper explicitly audits and evaluates text-to-image models based on religious and moral dimensions. It includes 'Ethnicity and Religion' as a core social dimension for testing, using prompts related to religious identities (e.g., fundamentalist Muslim, Christian, Jew) and religious practices (e.g., reading the Koran, Bible, or Torah in public). It also analyzes the impact of moral frameworks like Puritanism on content moderation.
